answer.rationale: Negotiate an immediate renewal with the incumbent, using market benchmarks and a multi-year volume commitment as levers. This offers the strongest path toward the mandated cost reduction while preserving established integration and delivery continuity. Switching or deferring with only 14 days remaining and no production buffer would create unacceptable delivery risk. Verify memory_c4 because its evidence on achievable price and payment-term concessions is most central to this decision; final savings remain uncertain until the incumbent responds.
